sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive recent run of five wins and a draw, travel away to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. This should be a straightforward encounter on paper—Alsager sit bottom of the league with just 4 points and a run of five consecutive losses—but Sandbach will be keen to maintain their winning momentum with another three points.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second place with 20 points, host struggling Dawley Town in what looks like a fixture they should control. AFC Bridgnorth, third on 19 points despite a recent loss, travel to Eccleshall (sixth, 18 points) in a competitive mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points and in good form, welcome Wednesfield Community (ninth, 13 points) at home. Bilston Town (fifth, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir (13th, 11 points), while Barnton (seventh, 15 points) host Shawbury United (15th, 10 points). New Mills (eighth, 14 points) travel to Market Drayton Town (tenth, 12 points) in a battle of mid-table sides. Crewe (16th, 9 points) take on Allscott Heath (11th, 11 points) in a lower-division encounter. Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, 7 points) face an uphill task away at Telford Town (18th, 6 points) in a basement battle. Finally, Brereton Social (14th, 11 points) host Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) in what should prove a heavily one-sided affair.
